goodToKnow: Satirisch means satirical: ein satirisches Magazin, satirisch überspitzt (exaggerated). Germany has a strong satire tradition, from Kurt Tucholsky, whose 1919 essay answered the question Was darf die Satire? with Alles, to the magazine Titanic and TV shows like the heute-show and extra 3. Die Satire is satire, der Satiriker a satirist. Satire is protected as free expression and art, within limits.
